---
title: "Documentation"
---

This website is made with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) from the `docs` folder, and published to [ribasim.nl](https://ribasim.nl/) from `main` by the workflow `.github/workflows/docs.yml`.

```sh
pixi run docs         # preview, with the viewer and the API reference
pixi run docs-render  # render as on CI
```

Quarto silently finds no pages if the repository is below a hidden folder, such as a worktree in `.claude/worktrees`. Render a copy elsewhere in that case.

## Diagrams

Use [Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/) for diagrams of steps and flows, in a `{mermaid}` code block, with short labels.
The theme is set in `docs/_quarto.yml`.
`pixi run dvc-dag` makes the full graph of the pipeline in `docs/dev/_dvc-dag.mmd`.

## Figures

The maps and charts of real examples are not in Git, and CI has no access to the data they are made from.
`scripts/docs_figures.py` makes them, and uploads them to `doc-image/figures` on MinIO, next to the other images of the docs.
The pages link to them there, so the docs do not need to be rebuilt to show new figures.

Every [catch-up run](pull-requests.qmd#catch-up-runs-on-main) publishes them after it has opened its pull request, so they follow the code of `main`:

```sh
pixi run docs-figures --pull --publish
```

If that fails, the catch-up run continues and logs it, and the docs keep the previous figures.
A figure that fails does not stop the others.

To work on a figure, make it locally in `data/docs_figures`, without uploading it:

```sh
pixi run docs-figures lumping         # one group, from the data you have
pixi run docs-figures --pull lumping  # pull its data first, as listed in the script
```

`--publish` needs credentials with write access in `.env`, and overwrites the figures on the live site, so only use it for a run of `main`.
A new figure needs its name in the `outputs` of its group; `scripts/test_docs_figures.py` checks that the pages only link to figures that are made.

Captions are written by hand, and do not follow the figures.
Keep them general where the figure can change, and check the numbers in those of [Lumping](../workflow/lumping.qmd) when its data changes.

## API reference

[quartodoc](https://machow.github.io/quartodoc/) builds the [API reference](../reference/index.qmd) from the docstrings, in the sections of `docs/_quarto.yml`.
